app.title: SoftEther VPN Server administration
lang.label: Language
error.upstream: The VPN server returned an unexpected error.
error.forbidden: Request rejected: invalid security token. Reload the page and try again.
csrf.expired: The form expired or its security token is not valid. Please try again.
setup.title: First access: set the administrator password
setup.intro: The VPN server has no server administrator password yet. Enter the one-time setup token, printed in the service journal and readable on the server with "softether-webadmin setup-token", and choose the new password (at least 12 characters).
setup.bad_token: The setup token is not valid.
setup.weak_password: The password is too short: use at least 12 characters.
setup.password_mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
setup.already_configured: The server is already configured. Log in with the server administrator password.
uncertain.title: Outcome uncertain
uncertain.body: The password change was sent, but its outcome could not be verified. It will not be sent again automatically.
status.password_set: The password has been set. You can now log in.
status.empty_password: The server password is still empty. Go back to the setup and try again.
status.unreachable: The VPN server is not reachable. Checking again...
status.cert_mismatch: The VPN server certificate is not the trusted one.
login.title: Log in
login.failed: Login failed: the password is wrong, or this computer's address is not allowed by the server's adminip.txt restriction.
login.rate_limited: Too many failed attempts. Try again later.
unreachable.title: VPN server unreachable
unreachable.body: The VPN server cannot be reached or did not answer in time.
unreachable.hint: Your session stays valid. Check that vpnserver is running; this page recovers when it is back.
certmismatch.title: VPN server certificate changed
certmismatch.body: The certificate presented by the VPN server is not the one trusted so far. No credentials were sent.
certmismatch.fix: If you expected the change, trust the new certificate by running this command on the server:
dashboard.title: Overview
adminip.title: Administration is not limited to this computer
adminip.missing: adminip.txt is missing: the VPN server accepts administration connections from any address.
adminip.not_isolated: adminip.txt allows administration from addresses other than loopback. Offending entries:
adminip.ignored: These adminip.txt lines are ignored by SoftEther (they are neither an address nor "*"):
adminip.unreadable: adminip.txt could not be read, so its restrictions are unknown.
adminip.confirm: I confirm: adminip.txt will be rewritten to allow loopback only (a backup is kept).
adminip.done: adminip.txt now allows loopback only. Backup of the previous file: %s
adminip.done_nobackup: adminip.txt now allows loopback only (there was no previous file).
